# zade — zad3.online

> Personal portfolio of zade — a developer from Romania who builds websites,
> experiments with new technologies, and makes small things for the internet.
> Living in the moment. Creating something real.

## Site

- Domain: https://zad3.online
- Type: single-page personal portfolio (static site)
- Language: English
- Theme: minimal, monochrome (black & white) editorial layout

## Pages

- `/` — the portfolio: hero with a live clock and greeting, an about section,
  a work/projects section, a contact section with social links, and a footer.
- `/404.html` — custom "page not found" screen in the same editorial style.

## Sections on the main page (anchor navigation)

- `/#top` — hero: name ("zade"), role (Developer · Creator), local time, greeting.
- `/#about` — a short bio: who zade is, what he focuses on (coding), where he's based (Romania).
- `/#work` — selected projects. Each project has a name, description, tech list and optional link.
- `/#contact` — contact links: Discord (heavenlygifted), Instagram (@z4de.1), email (me@zad3.online).

## Contact

- Email: me@zad3.online
- Discord: heavenlygifted
- Instagram: @z4de.1

## Notes for AI agents

- Content is driven by `config.json` — profile, theme, music, socials and SEO
  settings live there. Edits to that file change the site without touching HTML.
- `robots.txt` disallows `/admin.html`, `/push.html` and `/config.json` for crawlers;
  those are private tooling, not content pages.
- The site prefers `prefers-reduced-motion` and disables decorative animation for
  users who ask for reduced motion.
